newsitem.title: USA: Arbitrage fuels transatlantic crude offers into US.
newsitem.headline: Arbitrage fuels transatlantic crude offers into US.

text.p: Arbitrage opportunities fueled a slew of transatlantic offerings of June crude oil into the U.S. Gulf Coast on Monday, traders said.
Several cargoes of North Sea Brent were on offer for early to mid-June arrival, asking around 50-65 cents under June West Texas Intermediate/Cushing, traders said.

A European company was heard offering Brent for June 7-12, asking a 90-cent discount to WTI/Cushing. The unconfirmed price would not include lightering, which could add around 30 cents a barrel, traders said.
The June spread between WTI and Brent was around $1.65-70 cents a barrel Monday afternoon. Dated Brent activity was subdued amid a price run-up attributed to fundamental and technical factors.
West African offers were relatively abundant despite a resurgance of Asian buying in recent weeks.
Forcados and Qua Iboe were on offer for last decade June arrival, asking dated Brent plus $1.85 and plus $1.98, respectively, traders said.

A trading house sold a Nemba/Cabinda co-loader to an East Coast refiner for late-June arrival. The cargoes were sold at discounts of around five to seven cents and $1.00-1.15 a barrel to dated Brent, respectively, traders said.
From North Africa, a Saharan Blend was heard to be looking for a home in early June, asking dated Brent plus $2.10.
In Latin America, Venezuelan Mesa-30 was on offer at WTI/Cushing minus $3.20 a barrel in a steady upturn from last week, traders said.

Elsewhere in the region, Chile's state oil company Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (ENAP) bought 380,000 barrels of Oriente crude oil from a trading company in its latest purchase tender, market sources said.
The cargo is slated for delivery around June 25-30.
The crude was priced at an undisclosed discount to benchmark West Texas Intermediate/Cushing, the sources said.
The Ecuadoran grade is currently pegged around $3.35 cents under WTI/Cushing for early July delivery to the U.S. Gulf Coast.
